<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const drawerId = 'Giveaway-drawer-bottom-example'
    const showBtn = document.getElementById('Giveaway-drawer-show-btn')
    const closeBtn = document.getElementById('Giveaway-drawer-close-btn')
    const drawer = document.getElementById(drawerId)

    if (!showBtn || !closeBtn || !drawer) {
      console.log('Missing elements:', { showBtn, closeBtn, drawer })
      return
    }
    console.log('Drawer initialized successfully')

    function showDrawer() {
      console.log('showDrawer called, window width:', window.innerWidth)

      // 只在移动端显示
      if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) {
        console.log('Desktop mode, not showing drawer')
        return
      }

      // 移动到body确保正确定位
      document.body.appendChild(drawer)

      // 创建背景遮罩
      const backdrop = document.createElement('div')
      backdrop.id = drawerId + '-backdrop'
      backdrop.style.cssText =
        'position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0);z-index:9998;transition-property:background-color;transition-timing-function:cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);transition-duration:150ms;'
      backdrop.onclick = hideDrawer
      document.body.appendChild(backdrop)

      // 设置抽屉初始状态（隐藏在底部）
      drawer.style.cssText =
        'position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:9999;max-height:90vh;display:block;transform:translateY(100%);opacity:0;transition-property:transform;transition-timing-function:cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);transition-duration:150ms;'
      drawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false')

      // 触发动画（下一帧）
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        backdrop.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)'
        drawer.style.transform = 'translateY(0)'
        drawer.style.opacity = '1'

        // 触发内容动画
        const content = drawer.querySelector('.bg-white')
        if (content) {
          content.style.transform = 'translateY(0)'
          content.style.opacity = '1'
        }
      })

      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'
      console.log('Drawer shown successfully')
    }

    function hideDrawer() {
      const backdrop = document.getElementById(drawerId + '-backdrop')

      // 开始关闭动画
      if (backdrop) {
        backdrop.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'
      }

      // 使用指定的关闭动画
      drawer.style.transitionProperty = 'transform'
      drawer.style.transitionTimingFunction = 'cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)'
      drawer.style.transitionDuration = '150ms'
      drawer.style.transform = 'translateY(100%)'
      drawer.style.opacity = '0'

      // 动画完成后清理
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (backdrop && backdrop.parentNode) {
          backdrop.remove()
        }
        drawer.style.display = 'none'
        drawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true')
        document.body.style.overflow = ''
      }, 150) // 150ms 对应关闭动画时长
    }

    showBtn.onclick = showDrawer
    closeBtn.onclick = hideDrawer
  })
</script>
